content.stem: 在审查货币服务企业（MSB）的业务运营时，哪些活动会被视为洗钱的警示信号？（选择两项。）

options.A: 客户在办理国际电汇时，对提供受益人姓名或地址信息犹豫不决。
options.B: 现金密集型企业，例如便利店或餐馆，进行大额现金存款。
options.C: 一位客户将来自高风险司法管辖区的外币兑换为本币，兑换金额低于报告门槛。
options.D: 一位客户使用不同名称下的多个账户进行交易。
options.E: 一位客户经常向其本国汇出小额国际汇款。

content.stem_en: Which activities would be considered money laundering red flags when reviewing the business operations of a money services business (MSB)? (Select two.)

options_en.A: A customer being hesitant to provide beneficiary name or address information when sending international wire transfers.
options_en.B: Cash-intensive businesses, such as convenience stores or restaurants, making large cash deposits.
options_en.C: A customer exchanging foreign currency from a higher-risk jurisdiction for domestic currency under the reporting threshold.
options_en.D: A customer using multiple accounts under different names to conduct transactions.
options_en.E: A customer completing frequent small-dollar international money transfers to their native country.
